marks.conclusion: A policy or action classifier for a small 10x10 gridworld with 5 discrete actions (stay plus 4 directions); wall plane, a symmetric obstacle layout present in most examples, a global flag on the right wall, ch2 a target-like item.
marks.judge_notes: Channels credited: ch3 wall; ch2 'probably a target or item' (argued from smooth x/y readout, and it is not in its list of least-certain parts). ch0, ch1, ch4 called 'frequent entities'; not credited. Number of tasks: 2, reply said 'levels' (obstacle layout on in most examples, otherwise open room). Actions 1: 5 outputs read as stay plus 4 moves. Ruling on action meanings: it says output 0 has the smallest norm and fits no-op/stay (correct), but gives it as 'suggestive only' resting on a norm statistic and the usual ordering, so I gave 0 (default-or-guess rule). Depth level 1: cosine similarities between W3 columns are output-layer statistics, no first-layer link. Activation: 'ReLU hidden layers are likely' and 'softmax logits' are defaults with no argument from the weights, so 0; hedged, so no deduction. Training method 0. Rubric/brief mismatch: the rubric says 'mark the first reply only' but the brief says mark every file; every file was marked independently.
